media.alt: Philip Wood awarded prestigious British Academy grant
Philip Wood awarded prestigious British Academy grant

content.text: ISMC is delighted to announce that Philip Wood has been awarded a British Academy Rising Star Engagement Award. The award will be used to support a two-day workshop later this year to train academics in how to communicate their research via digital media.

ISMC's Director, David Taylor, said; "Congratulations to Philip on a major mark of recognition by the UK's most senior body in the humanities and social sciences. Our colleague, Sarah Savant received the same award a year ago. For a small institution like ours to receive two of these highly competitive awards is a remarkable achievement."

The British Academy's Rising Star Engagement Awards (BARSEA) enables established early career scholars to actively engage in the work of the Academy and to enhance their own skills and career development through the organisation of events, training, and mentoring activities for a wide range of other early career researchers.

Philip Wood summed up what the award will mean; "The support from the British Academy will enable ISMC to early to mid-career academics an opportunity to improve their knowledge and understanding of digital media - an increasingly important avenue for all of us to ensure our work is publicised."
